adds.name: Gifts Ungiven
adds.why: Option, Game Changer #3 for the Bracket 3 version (with The One Ring and Orcish Bowmasters). Not in the deck yet; you own 2 copies and the other is earmarked for the Norman Osborn deck. {3}{U} instant: search for up to four cards with different names; target opponent chooses two of them to go to your graveyard and the rest come to your hand. You choose the opponent, but the opponent chooses the split, so build piles where any split helps you. Fetch fewer than four to change the result: two cards means both go to the graveyard (a pure reanimation setup), three means you keep one. It can't reliably find one specific card. Suggested cut: Read the Bones.

bracketGoal: 0 Game Changers · no 2-card infinites · pain lands, no fetches or shocks
name: Sauron: Eye of Barad-dûr
notes: Plan: grow one Orc/Goblin Army, connect with it to tempt the Ring, then refill with Sauron's discard-and-draw-four. Mauhúr and The Great Goblin turn every amass into extra counters or damage.
Your opponents build the Army for you: Sauron amasses Orcs 1 on every spell they cast, so leave mana up for Saruman's Trickery and the counters.
Amassing Goblins puts counters on your existing Orc Army and makes it a Goblin too, so the Hobbit cards stack on the same body.

Every Ring tempt can trigger the discard-and-draw: Call of the Ring does it each upkeep, plus Nazgûl, Bilbo, Gollum, Birthday Escape, Ringsight and more. Only take it when your hand is worse than four fresh cards.
Discarded creatures come back with Reanimate, Animate Dead, Persist, Grim Discovery and Gathering of Darkness. Psychosis Crawler pings everyone each time you draw four.
Ward on Sauron makes opponents sacrifice a legendary, so single-target removal is costly for them.

The other three Saurons (Nov 13): Lidless Eye steals a creature for a turn and its {1}{B}{R} pump drains each opponent 2; Necromancer attacks to reanimate a creature as a 3/3 menace Wraith (kept if he's your Ring-bearer); Lord of the Rings is the 8-drop finisher: its cast trigger amasses 5, mills 5 and reanimates even if it's countered, and it's a great discard target for Reanimate or Animate Dead. Cut for them: Fearsome Goblin Pair, Rhovanion Rampager, Tidings of War.

Commander and all three other Saurons owned. Ownership check before sleeving: Sol Ring, Command Tower, and the rares Call of the Ring, Sauron's Ransom, Assault on Osgiliath, Barad-dûr and The Great Goblin. Swap any you lack for a cards-to-add pick or a basic.
No true board wipe. Interaction is counters, spot removal and Foray of Orcs.
source: Built from Andrew's LOTR and Hobbit booster cards plus his staples, Nov 6, 2026

notes: Nov 15 generic sim: Sauron lands on turn 6.9 on average in the main list. This package put him on curve 63% of the time instead of 59% and moved pod win rate from 15.5% to 16.1%. Small, but it costs about $2.
The check lands are almost always untapped with 24 basics left.
For the Bracket 3 version: The One Ring measured nothing in this sim (12.8% with it, 13.5% without). The sim cannot value the Ring tempt engine, so read that as 'not proven', not 'bad'.
